description: Compare two runs of the same skill and report SAME or DRIFTED — the drift-detector for a recorded baseline replayed on a schedule. Compares per-step outcomes, structure, and heal-level from .reelier/runs/<skill>.jsonl (defaults to the last two runs); data values that legitimately change run-to-run are NOT drift. Drifted steps carry why (the failing assertion). To check a MODEL upgrade: re-record the workflow with the new model, then diff against your frozen baseline — replaying a pinned skill can't reveal model changes (replay never calls a model). Honest when there aren't two runs yet.

baselineIndex.description: 0-based index of the baseline run (default: second-to-last).

candidateIndex.description: 0-based index of the candidate run (default: the last run).

cwd.description: Working directory where .reelier/ lives (default: the serve --workspace root when one was given, else process cwd).

skill.description: Skill name (the .reelier/runs/<skill>.jsonl stem) whose runs to compare.

name: reelier_diff
